design_philosophy: Ultra conversion-optimized, fast, and mobile-first automotive buyback landing page. Professional, trustworthy, and fast. Relies on high-contrast primary CTAs (Orange) against deep authoritative backgrounds (Dark Blue) and clean white/gray spaces for forms.

primary.description: High-visibility action color for Main CTAs, Sticky Estimate Button, and active progress steps.

secondary.description: Deep Dark Blue for Headings, Footer, Header, and high-contrast section backgrounds.

background.description: Crisp white and light gray alternating sections to separate content clearly.

success.description: Green accents for form validation, checkmarks, and reassuring security messages.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1E2A44]

typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep tight line-heights for headings and generous line-heights for body text. Use bold weights for numbers and key stats.

spacing_and_layout.mobile_first_rules: Always stack columns on mobile. Ensure tap targets (buttons, inputs) are at least 48px high. Forms must have massive input fields for easy typing on mobile.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF5C00] text-white hover:bg-[#E65200] font-bold text-lg px-8 py-4 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-lg active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1E2A44] text-white hover:bg-[#2A3A5E] font-bold px-6 py-3 rounded-xl transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#1E2A44] text-[#1E2A44] hover:bg-gray-50 font-bold px-6 py-3 rounded-xl

inputs.license_plate: text-center text-3xl font-black tracking-widest uppercase border-4 border-gray-300 focus:border-[#FF5C00] rounded-xl h-16 w-full placeholder:text-gray-300
inputs.standard: bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 focus:border-[#FF5C00] focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#FF5C00]/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 w-full text-lg
inputs.label: block text-sm font-bold text-[#1E2A44] mb-2

cards.base: bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-100 shadow-lg shadow-black/5 p-6 md:p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300

shadcn_customizations.carousel: Use for Vehicle Examples and Testimonials. Add visible navigation arrows on desktop, swipeable on mobile.
shadcn_customizations.progress: Use for the 6-step form indicator. Color the filled track with #FF5C00 and background with gray-200.

icons.usage: Use Car for vehicles, ShieldCheck for security/trust, Clock for speed (24h), Star for reviews, MapPin for centers, CheckCircle2 for green validations.

form_strategy.design_rules: Keep the form inside a dedicated high-focus card container. Hide distractions during the form steps. Use large, selectable tiles instead of standard dropdowns for choices like 'Condition' (e.g., Excellent, Good, Average) to optimize mobile UX.

header.layout: Sticky top, z-50, bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-gray-100
header.content: Logo (left), Sticky 'Estimer mon véhicule' Button (right, hidden when hero CTA is visible).

hero.layout: Relative full width, min-h-[80vh] flex items-center
hero.background: Dark overlay (bg-[#1E2A44]/80) over modern car background image
hero.content: H1 'Vendez votre voiture en 24h', Subtitle 'Estimation gratuite et sans engagement', large License Plate Input Box directly in hero, massive Orange 'Estimer' CTA.
hero.trust_badges: Below CTA: 'Paiement sécurisé', 'Sans engagement', 'Vendu en 24h' with Lucide ShieldCheck/Clock icons in green/white.

social_proof.content: Trustpilot style stars (5 green stars), '+500 véhicules vendus ce mois-ci', 'Élu service client de l\'année'.

how_it_works.content: Section Title: 'Comment ça marche ?'. 3 Bento-style Grid Cards: 1. Estimez en ligne (Icon: Laptop), 2. Prenez rendez-vous (Icon: Calendar), 3. Recevez votre paiement (Icon: Banknotes). Add subtle step numbers (1, 2, 3) behind icons.

vehicle_examples.content: Title: 'Ils nous ont fait confiance'. Shadcn Carousel showing recent cars purchased with estimated price overlays (e.g., 'Peugeot 208 - Achetée 12 500€').

testimonials.content: Title: 'Avis Clients'. 3 Column grid of review cards. Dark cards with white text, 5 yellow/orange stars, customer avatars.

contact_centers.content: Title: 'Trouvez un centre près de chez vous'. 2 Columns: Text info + Contact Details vs Placeholder Map / Center List (Paris, Lyon, Marseille).

footer.content: Logo, Links (CGV, Mentions légales, Contact), Copyright 2026.

sticky_estimate_cta.behavior: Fixed at the bottom of the screen on mobile, or bottom right on desktop. Only appears after scrolling past the Hero section. Massive Orange Button: 'Estimer ma voiture'. z-50.

animations.hover: Buttons scale down slightly (active:scale-95) for tactile feedback. Cards lift slightly (hover:-translate-y-1).
animations.form_transitions: Framer Motion slide-in (x: 20, opacity: 0 -> x: 0, opacity: 1) between form steps.
animations.scroll: Fade-up entrance animations for main sections.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #FF5C00 passes contrast. #1E2A44 provides massive contrast for reading.
accessibility.focus: All form inputs must have focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#FF5C00]/20 for clear keyboard navigation.
accessibility.test_ids: All buttons, inputs, and form step navigations MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes.

hero_background.description: Dark sedan parked on a gravel road. Perfect for placing a dark #1E2A44/80 overlay to make white text pop.

vehicle_example_1.description: Exterior view of car dealership, cars under bright sky.

vehicle_example_2.description: Row of SUVs parked in a lot.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the multi-step form inside the Hero section or directly below it as the primary interactive element.
Implement the progressive form using a state manager (e.g. React state with `step` variable). Only show one step at a time.
Ensure the license plate input (Step 1) has a distinct visual style (look like an actual European license plate: white/blue borders, centered text).
Use Shadcn UI components for inputs, selects (or selectable cards for better mobile UX), progress bar, and carousels.
Strictly follow the color palette. #FF5C00 is reserved ONLY for the primary action buttons (Submit, Next Step, Estimate). Do not use it for text or backgrounds unless specified.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive element (form inputs, buttons, step nav).
Implement the Sticky 'Estimer' button to appear on scroll for mobile and desktop, linking back to the form.
